scripts.lint: eslint scripts && pnpm -r --if-present lint && prettier --check scripts apps packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .github README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.format: prettier --write scripts apps packages package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .github README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @study-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @study-platform/ui build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:workflow && pnpm --filter @study-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @study-platform/ui build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter @study-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @study-platform/ui build && concurrently --kill-others --success all --names web,api,email,classroom "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm --filter @study-platform/api email:worker" "pnpm dev:classroom"
